question: El ingreso de agosto de 2026 fue mayor o menor que el de marzo de 2026, y en que porcentaje?

baseline.model_output:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date) > 
             SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date DESC) THEN 'mayor'
        ELSE 'menor'
    END AS result,
    CAST(
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date DESC) - 
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date) AS REAL
    ) * 100 / SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY sale_date ORDER BY sale_date DESC) AS percentage
FROM 
    sales
WHERE 
    sale_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
ORDER BY 
    sale_date DESC
LIMIT 1;
